reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Institution of quiet title action to determine real property interests
headings.reviewNote: Permits any person claiming a legal or equitable, vested or contingent, present or future interest in real property, whether in possession or not, to sue adverse claimants to ascertain and determine title.

headings.title: Court may determine all pleaded claims and award full relief
headings.reviewNote: Provides that upon request in either party's pleadings, the court may determine all rights, claims, interests, liens, and demands affecting the property and award full legal or equitable relief with conclusive effect.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked both subsections and 1971 Carroz v. Kaminiski boundary-dispute annotation for 527.150. Tightened subsection 2 title to reflect permissive judicial authority to determine all pleaded claims and award full legal or equitable relief.

headings.title: Proceedings to establish title upon loss or destruction of deed records
headings.reviewNote: Permits claimants whose deeds, mortgages, written title evidence, or records thereof were lost or destroyed to petition the circuit court with land and instrument descriptions.

headings.title: Pleading manner of loss, adjudication, and petition verification
headings.reviewNote: Requires the petition to state how the title evidence was lost or destroyed, pray for hearing and recording of proof, provides for court adjudication of title upon hearing, and requires verification by affidavit.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked both subsections and history notes for 527.190. Corrected subsection 2 title and note, which had inaccurately claimed it required pleading adverse claimants rather than the manner of loss/destruction, adjudication upon hearing, and petition verification.

headings.title: Verified petition for name change in circuit court
headings.reviewNote: Permits any person desiring a name change to present a verified petition to the circuit court of residence stating full name, desired name, and reason, and directs the judge to order the change if proper and not detrimental.

headings.title: Name change prohibited during required registry period
headings.reviewNote: Notwithstanding subsection 1, prohibits any person required to register under sections 589.400 to 589.425 from changing his or her name during the required registration period.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked both subsections and notes (including 2026 merger and severability clause reference to § 1.1005) for 527.270. Removed unsupported 'adult or minor' wording from subsection 1 and aligned subsection 2 with the statutory cross-reference to sections 589.400 to 589.425.

headings.title: Public notice of name change by publication in county newspaper
headings.reviewNote: Requires public notice of a name change order to be published at least three times within twenty days in a county newspaper, or if none in the county or an adjacent county, in St. Louis City or the seat of government.

headings.title: Publication and online posting exemptions for abuse or violence victims
headings.reviewNote: Exempts petitioners who are victims of crimes involving domestic violence (§ 455.010), child abuse (§ 210.110), or domestic violence by a family or household member from newspaper publication and electronic judicial public case posting.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked both subsections and history notes for 527.290. Corrected subsection 2 title and note to reflect the specific domestic violence and child abuse victim categories and both publication and electronic judicial posting exemptions.
